info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Position Management API
info.description: The Customer Position Management API provides access to essential customer account information, enabling users to retrieve detailed positions of customer accounts in the banking system. By utilizing this endpoint, financial institutions can effectively monitor account balances, investment statuses, and transaction histories. This API is particularly beneficial for banking applications, analytics tools, and reporting services that aim to enhance customer relationship management. Typical consumers include bank employees, customer service representatives, and financial analysts seeking timely data on customer account standings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific customer position by its unique identifier. You will receive comprehensive information related to that customer position, such as balance, transaction history, and associated accounts.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the customer position details for a specific customer identified by the ID 'CUST-100045'. Ensure the format adheres to the specified schema to enable proper processing and retrieval of customer information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the customer position details.
